headline: Reform Alliance Wins Reykjavik Snap Election by 12.5-Point Margin
summary: The Reform Alliance won Iceland's snap parliamentary election with 54.3 percent of the vote, defeating the incumbent National Front. Reform Alliance leader Lina Aksel will form the next government, replacing outgoing Prime Minister Marin Volkov, who conceded shortly after midnight in Reykjavik. The election commission confirmed final results after a record 78 percent turnout.
key_points: Reform Alliance secured 54.3 percent of the vote against the National Front's 41.8 percent
Turnout reached 78 percent — the highest in three decades
Lina Aksel will form the next government in Reykjavik as Prime Minister-elect
Outgoing Prime Minister Marin Volkov conceded shortly after midnight

source_documents.title: Iceland Election Commission - Final Tally
source_documents.quote_text: We thank Icelanders for the highest turnout this republic has seen in thirty years.
